about: Interface values a replacement Rule 60 V3 part must match: the stock top case it replaces or mates with, the INKC plate, the stock gasket caps and ball catches, and fitted hardware. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. Status: caliper (owner, digital caliper on the stock part), photo (photo metrology), fit (found by printing and fitting), dwg (INKC drawing), published (creator post), datasheet, derived (computed from other entries), assumed, estimated. Design choices of this housing (joints, wrist rest, pockets' clearances) live in build_topcase_draft.py, not here.

frames.plate: Plate frame: top view, X right, Y back (away from the typist); origin at the bounding-box lower-left of the INKC 6095(top) plate. The 6095(gas) plate sits at (0, +1.018). See spec/rule60-v3-outlines.json.
frames.z_p: Z_p: height through the top case, 0 at the top face, growing toward the skirt lip (the print frame: top face on the bed).

top.bottom_seat_z.source: evidence/topcase/photos/IMG_0334.jpg: floor the bottom-case rim seats on, pocketed 10.32 deep from the lip

top.bezel.source: owner, 2026-10-29: top-face bezel from the outer edge to the keycap opening (front: outside the HHKB blockers)

top.rim_seat_w.source: short-side underside steps 2.85 / 4.90 / 5.66 from the outer edge (caliper, owner 2026-10-29): 4.90 - 2.85

top.inner_corner_r.source: v6.2 print: an R5.0 pocket held the stock bottom case ~2.3 mm off at the corners, so its corners are about R2.7; R2.0 clears them (evidence/topcase/photos/IMG_0370-0373)

top.tilt_deg.source: INKC group-buy post https://www.zfrontier.com/app/flow/daWn5PAnGgxG: 输入角度 6°, 前高 20mm

top.keycap_opening_hhkb.source: HHKB keycap opening bounds (plate frame, x0 y0 x1 y1) around the DWG switch grid (Esc centre 9.600, 91.869; pitch 19.05); front edge at the bottom-row middle, HHKB blockers 30 deep from the outer edge (caliper 30.02)

top.usb_notch.source: width and R1.5 closed-end corners from the stock notch photographed lip to lip on the v6.2 print (evidence/topcase/photos/IMG_0378-0379, stock 12.6 / 12.75); depth from the v7.3 full-print fit. The centre depends on the PCB: spec/boards.json

top.usb_notch_cable_width.source: width the printed cases cut their USB-C notch and slot to, at least top.usb_notch.width: the --board universal width (12.8 + the 1.95 mm spread of measured on-board USB centres), so a 12.35 mm USB-C maximum overmold clears 1.2 mm per side and a ~13 mm retail plug 0.875. Set it to 12.8 for the stock notch

plate.thickness.source: silicone-cap stack 1.5 top flange + 1.5 PC plate + 1.5 bottom flange (evidence/topcase/analysis/underside-photo-annotated.jpg)

plate.front_tabs_x.source: rule60-v3.dwg 6095(gas) front T-tab X spans, 41.0 wide (spec/rule60-v3-outlines.json plate_gas)

plate.back_tabs_x.source: rule60-v3.dwg 6095(gas) back T-tab X spans (the USB-side tab sits 10 mm inward)

plate.tab_mid_y.source: centre lines of the gas tabs, Y 1.07-4.07 front and 103.42-106.42 back

plate.body_y.source: gas plate body Y span between the tab relief slots

gasket.cap_free.source: Keebox 'Silicone Gaskets Feets 20 Pcs' (AliExpress 1005008463912507, https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005008463912507.html), listing drawing: outer 8 x 5 x 5, inner 6.5 x 2.8 x 1.2, 'Fit 1.2mm-1.6mm pcb/plate'; a U-sock with a rounded (R2.5) end that slides onto a tab end, 1.9 mm flanges either side of the slot. Owner confirmed it as the stock Rule60 V3 cap (2026-11-01). The kit ships 15 (12 used). Earlier photo read: 8.3 x 5.5 x 4.5

gasket.pocket_footprint.source: cap footprint L x W read off the rectified stock underside photo (evidence/topcase/analysis/underside-photo-annotated.jpg): the basis the top-case pockets and bottom-case recesses are sized from (+ CAP_CLEAR), not the part's size (gasket.cap_free). The owner's v7.4 print took the stock caps in these pockets; the datasheet cap, pushed fully onto the tab, clears them by 0.02-0.05 mm free

gasket.pocket_inset.source: pocket centre from each tab end, same photo: 43.0 mm outer span over a 41.0 mm tab. A datasheet cap pushed fully on centres 2.5 mm in and overhangs the tab end by 1.5 mm

gasket.top_flange_compressed.source: (3.90 seat gap - 1.5 plate) / 2, gap = 6.30 top-case seat (caliper) to the 10.20 bottom-case seat: 0.70 mm compression of each 1.9 mm datasheet flange (37 %). The stock gap reads about 4 mm (DCInside mechanicalkeyboard no=2088423: space ~4 mm, cap 5 mm, plate 1.5, ~1 mm squeeze), i.e. ~0.65 per flange; the bottom-case fit coupon decides

gasket.cap_height_compressed.source: the seat gap: two compressed flanges (gasket.top_flange_compressed) + 1.5 plate

ball_catch.strike_sites.source: [name, plate X, inner skirt wall faced, centre distance from that wall]. X: homography of IMG_0201 on the 8 top-mount holes, RMS 0.13 mm (evidence/topcase/analysis/ball-catch-analysis.json). Back distances: two-view fit IMG_0218/0222. Front distances are not measured: centred in the 7.6 mm band between the inner front wall and the plate edge

ball_catch.strike_plate.source: stock strike plate, ball-catch-analysis.json + two-view silhouette fit IMG_0218/0222

ball_catch.strike_tongue.source: tongue X x Y x Z rising from the strike plate toward the bottom case, same fit

ball_catch.strike_pocket.source: stock CNC strike pocket: 7.25 wide, 'mushroom' end reliefs (4.1 lobe 4.55 past the plate end on the skirt half, end wall 2.15 past it, R0.85 shoulder); two-view ray-cast fit IMG_0218 + IMG_0222 (evidence/topcase/analysis/strike-pocket-fit-v7.10.png)

ball_catch.catch_body.source: stock double-ball catch on the bottom-case rim (2 barrels 8.0 long, 5.2 slot, 3.5 ball gap free): evidence/topcase/analysis/ball-catch-analysis.json, +-0.4..0.6. The top-case strike-pocket lobes (ball_catch.strike_pocket) sit on its screw centres: 12.75 from the strike centre, 1.575 toward the skirt

keycaps.hhkb_gauge.source: HHKB 60-key keycap footprint (plate frame): DWG switch grid with each 19.05 cell inset 0.4 mm, bottom-row blockers 1.5u from each side

bottom.battery_bay.source: Depth: owner caliper on the stock bottom case, 2026-10-31 (4.69; the INKC interest-check post https://www.zfrontier.com/app/flow/GJ7JjlX8qwxY publishes 电池仓 45x140x4.5mm r2). Length, width, corner radius: published; position not published. The 4.5 mm filler block is outline battery_bay_filler in spec/rule60-v3-outlines.json

bottom.weight_plate_holes.source: Tapped holes of the stock steel weight plate (outline back_deco_plate, in its own frame: X along the 239.6 length, Y 0 at the centre-bump tip, Y 35.6 the straight back edge), screwed from inside the case. IMG_0474 (inside, top-down): four M2-size heads (~3.4 mm) in counterbores, two per plate end, rectified on the plate's own outline seen through the floor; left and right ends agree within 0.6 mm and are averaged into a mirror-symmetric pattern, +-0.5 mm (edge fit, head-to-plate parallax). IMG_0463 (outside) shows no holes in the plate face, so they are blind. Not measured

bumpon.sj5012.source: 3M Bumpon Protective Products SJ5012 (same shape: SJ5312 transparent, SJ5412 true white), cylindrical flat top; https://multimedia.3m.com/mws/media/117314O/3m-bumpon-protective-products-molded-shapes-colored-and-clear.pdf

desk.gap.source: gap between the desk and the top-case skirt lip with the keyboard on its stock feet: the v9 wrist rest was sized to 22 mm installed against the 20.01 mm case. Not measured
